about: Jason's listening verdicts from past build sessions, as labels for the digital ear (docs/taste.md). Notes are paraphrased; tags use js/ear-data.js TAGS. prs are the PRs under review when the verdict was given. A verdict says what was wrong, not which exact render, so these seed the tag vocabulary and per-genre priors; ear.html pairs are the training target.
